commands:
cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
echo "=== loop-verdict-marker-test.py ==="; python3 lib/test/loop-verdict-marker-test.py; echo "rc=$?"
echo "=== capability --check ==="; python3 lib/generate-capability-profiles.py --check 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "=== cloud_writer_contract verify ==="; python3 lib/test/cloud_writer_contract.py verify 2>&1 | tail -20; echo "rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
echo "=== ruff on new files ==="; ruff check scripts/loop-verdict-marker.py lib/test/loop-ver …[per-command-truncated]
git log --oneline --first-parent -15 25b6cbd9; echo ===; git log --oneline 25b6cbd9 --not $(git rev-list --max-count=1 25b6cbd9^2 2>/dev/null) 2>/dev/null | head

printf '\xff\xfe not utf8\n<!-- prflow:loop-verdict result=approve coverage=full -->' > /tmp/lvm_bad.md
python3 scripts/loop-verdict-marker.py read /tmp/lvm_bad.md; echo "rc=$?"
echo "--- locale check for stdin errors handler ---"
python3 -c "import sys; print(sys.stdin.errors)"

cd /home/runner/work/prflow/prflow
printf '\xff\xfe not utf8\nsecond line\n' > .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md 2>/dev/null || { mkdir -p .prflow/tmp; printf '\xff\xfe not utf8\nsecond line\n' > .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md; }
python3 scripts/loop-verdict-marker.py read .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md; echo "file rc=$?"
python3 -c "import sys; print('stdin.errors=', sys.stdin.errors)"
rm -f .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp && printf '\xff\xfe bad\nsecond\n' > .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md && python3 scripts/loop-verdict-marker.py read .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md; echo "file rc=$?"; python3 -c "import sys; print('stdin.errors=', sys.stdin.errors)"; rm -f .prflow/tmp/lvm_bad.md

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
